content.short: Zyfai uses rule-based agents to move your assets into the best risk-adjusted DeFi yields.
content.description: Zyfai runs rule-based agents that deploy users' assets across vetted DeFi pools and chains, rebalancing towards the best risk-adjusted yield. Funds stay in the user's own smart account under rules they set, and developers can integrate it through an SDK. DefiLlama tracks Zyfai on Plasma and Plasma's official ecosystem directory lists it.
content.meta: Zyfai uses rule-based agents in your own smart account to chase risk-adjusted DeFi yield, including on Plasma.
